metadata.project: Gore Alternate History — Federal Budget Ledger
metadata.description: Tracking the federal surplus, debt pay-down, and major program funding under the Gore Administration.
metadata.canon_status: Aligned with 2001 CBO Baseline + WTP/MATF legislative stack

surplus_summary.notes: WTP1 enacted; debt pay-down begins in earnest.
GridSmart program launched; infrastructure investment begins.
AutoFile implementation reduces IRS overhead and increases compliance.
WTP6 House expansion; McMillan Complex construction funded.
WTP5 enforcement leads to first major Corruption Asset Recovery inflows.
Pre-MATF baseline; surplus used to offset 0% work-income tax rate.
First full year of MATF; wealth tax, FTT, and reformed estate tax revenue partially offsets 0% work-income rate.

RAILS.notes: All investments required to be HSR-compatible per RAILS Act Provision 3. The STL-CHI corridor was added via a 2004 amendment.

AMERSAT.notes: Revenue derived from international licensing and urban retail service; rural service provided at cost.

GRIDSMART.notes: Funded via DOE Smart Grid Investment Office.

MAGA_AOI.notes: Omnibus rural infrastructure program enacted in 2007, funded via direct appropriations.

SOLAR_INITIATIVE.notes: Funding for the Solar Energy Initiative Act of 2001 to onshore the solar supply chain and drive down costs.

RAILS_NATIONAL.funding_source: High-Speed Rail Trust Fund & General Appropriations
RAILS_NATIONAL.notes: Funding for the National High-Speed Rail Act of 2006. The 10-year budget auto-renews annually and includes a $1B authorization for an initial fleet of 6 TBMs.

corruption_asset_recovery_fund.usage: Public campaign finance matching pool and America First Forever trust funds

provisions: Step-up in basis elimination for estates > $5M
matf_loophole_closures.economic_intent: Maintain surplus trajectory while providing 0% work-income tax rate for the middle class.

matf_ultra_wealth_tax.notes: Utilizes WTP4 beneficial ownership data for real-time valuation; primary funding source for America First Forever trust funds.

financial_transaction_tax.notes: Targets high-frequency churn; revenue directed to Social Security Trust Fund backfill.

exec_pay_deduction_penalty.notes: Revenue from corporations choosing to maintain high executive pay despite lost tax deductions.

matf_estate_tax.notes: Revenue from the reformed three-tier estate tax (0% <$5M, 20% $5M-$20M, 77% >$20M).

affa_funding.pilot_phase_funding: 2-year pilot at $1 million per day (approx. $730M total).
affa_funding.ongoing_funding: 10% of the annual federal budget surplus, beginning in FY2007.
affa_funding.usage: Capitalization of AFFA trust funds (health, rural opportunity, etc.).
affa_funding.notes: Capitalizes the sovereign wealth trust funds for long-term domestic program stability.

airline_fuel_excise_tax.usage: Capitalization of the High-Speed Rail Trust Fund.
airline_fuel_excise_tax.notes: A new excise tax on commercial airline fuel to create a dedicated funding stream for HSR.

debt_status.notes: Avoidance of 2001/2003 tax cuts and Iraq War costs preserved approximately $3.5T in capital; pre-emptive regulation via the 2005 Financial Stability Act mitigated the 2008 subprime crisis, maintaining the surplus trajectory.

alternate_history_gdp.source: Gemini Code Assist Economic Model (Gore Canon)
alternate_history_gdp.notes: Based on avoiding 2001/2008 recessions, pre-emptive regulation (FSA2005), and sustained investment from budget surpluses.
